svg.aria-label: Crew workflow: the planner plans, the skeptic attacks the plan, the crew asks one decision, Lucia answers, the tester finds an old crash, the reviewer requires changes twice and then approves

g.text: You
Lucia (you)
/crew:ship add online ordering with pickup time slots to the bakery website
planner
Order form, 30-minute slots, 4 orders each, pay at pickup.
Slots come from the opening hours in Bratislava time, with tests for DST.
skeptic
A slot count kept in memory resets on every restart.
Anyone could fill every slot, and an async route can crash Express 4.
GO WITH CHANGES
crew · checkpoint · asks you
One decision: drop slot capacity (A) or save orders (B)?
A is simpler. B needs a file store and a limit per email address.
You
Lucia (you)
B: 8 per slot, orders close at 14:00 the day before.
At most 3 open orders per email. The cancel link waits for phase 2.
tester
A repeated form field hangs the old contact form.
app.ts:135 renders an array and Express 4 drops the error. One curl reproduces it.
4 FAILED
reviewer
A short script can book out two weeks of slots.
1 920 places, no rate limit, no honeypot. Error pages also leak stack traces.
CHANGES REQUIRED
reviewer · round 2
The double-click fix now drops a changed second order.
Back, change the day, submit: the customer lands on the first order.
CHANGES REQUIRED
reviewer · round 3
Approved. Two rare double-failure cases go on the follow-up list.
APPROVE WITH NITS
crew · for the client
Ordering is built: 323 tests pass, nothing is committed.
You get the diff, the test results and a commit message to approve.
crew · asks you
Before go-live: how is the site deployed?
A per-IP limit depends on the proxy, and real email still isn't wired.
